notes:
First public release, everything from 1.2.x in one go.

- Quests: make, edit and install event quests, see monster health before you go in, search your quests
- Builds: editor, a calculator that maxes skills in your order, import loadouts from the game and send builds back
- Icons for all gear and decorations
- Themes
- Updates install from inside the app now

Full history is in CHANGELOG.md on GitHub.
